description:
The surviving profile model names packages by the domain `ProfileId`, and the separate unvalidated package identifier type `ProfilePackageId` is removed.

## Background

`ProfilePackageId` is defined at `crates/jit/src/repository_state/profile_apply.rs:608`. Before the record deletion it appeared 71 times; roughly a third survive (line numbers at the investigation baseline):

- Contribution claims (`ProfileContributionClaim.package_id`, `ProfileClaims.package_id`).
- Composed owners (`ComposedContribution.owners`).
- The conflict-origin type.
- Constructors in `crates/jit/src/profile/apply_claims.rs` (109, 128).

Test uses sit in `profile_apply.rs`, `crates/jit/src/repository_state/materialize.rs`, `crates/jit/src/repository_state/initialize.rs`, `crates/jit/src/commands/profile.rs` and `crates/jit/src/main.rs`. The validated `ProfileId` lives in the domain layer.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: No `ProfilePackageId` type remains, and each former use holds the domain `ProfileId`.
- [hard] REQ-02: Conflict parties, contribution claims and composed owners carry `ProfileId`.
- [hard] REQ-03: Serialized output of these fields is unchanged.

## Notes

The record deletion removes the profile-id string comparisons in record code. The surviving comparisons in dependency resolution belong to the domain identity work.
title: Identify profile packages by the domain profile id
